full_judgment:
4. The learned SCC Judge decreed the suit by judgment and decree dated 2-5-90. The petitioners challenged the said judgment and decree under section 25 of the Small Causes Court Act and obtained a Rule in Civil Revision Case No. 1136 of 1990 and the same has been maintained by the High Court Division by its judgment dated 12-11-91 in discharging the Rule on merit. 

 6. Mr. Miah Abdul Gafur, learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the petitioners sought to reagitate his submissions he had made before the High Court Division, namely, the trial Court decreed the suit on the ground that the tenancy on the death of Badsha Miah being not heritable ceased, relying on the decision reported in 32 DLR (AD) 170, and as such there was no legal requirement of serving a notice under section 106, but the said decision having been reversed by this court in the case-law reported in 44 DLR (AD) 1 making such tenancy heritable, the learned judge of the High Court Division ought to have held that the suit was not maintainable without a notice under section 106.
